summary: Frontend-only audit of the rebuilt engineering visuals of sections 05-12 on /construction.html (public preview URL). Verified: global overflow + console errors at 7 viewports (1600x1000, 1440x900, 1366x768, 1280x800, 1024x768, 834x1112, 390x844), 05 cage six-phase scroll synchronisation forwards and in reverse (21 samples each way, desktop + mobile), 06 verification-cell/label/control-column identity at 4 sizes, 07 continuity trace + discontinuity window, 08 envelope figure label geometry at 4 sizes, 09 five transmission-path schematics (desktop + mobile), 10 all seven MEP tabs + fire layer content + geometric review of service routes vs structure, 11 register grouping/rows, 12 convergence diagram vs closing copy + photo dissolve, plus a regression pass on 01-04, header and footer. Approved-copy gate /app/scripts/cx_verify_0512.py still passes (227 lines, CONTENT INTEGRITY OK). One functional state-skipping defect found in section 06 on pinned-horizontal desktop, plus several legibility/overlap defects.

ui_bugs.issue: STATE SKIPPING on pinned horizontal desktop (width>=1201 and height>820): measured stops = [0,528,1056,1584,1616,1616] because each stop is clamped to (scrollWidth - innerWidth). The last two columns share the same stop, so the nearest-stop lookup can never resolve to index 5. At every progress up to 1.0 the active column stays C.05 / cx-elstate-5 (ENCLOSURE) and only 5 of the 6 verification cells ever fill; C.06 'Completion & verification', cx-elstate-6 and the COMPLETION cell are unreachable. Verified at 1600x1000 and 1440x900 forwards and reverse (34 samples each). Vertical fallback at 1366x768 and 390x844 correctly reaches state 6, so it is desktop-only.

Illegible drawing: svg max-height clamp(60px, 9.5vh, 150px) scales the 1200x200 viewBox by ~0.47, so the 9px labels render only ~4-5px tall (measured height 5.0px for 'VERIFICATION BEFORE WORK IS CONCEALED', DOCUMENTATION, PRE-POUR, CONCRETE EXECUTION, EARLY AGE, ENCLOSURE, COMPLETION) at 1600x1000; smaller still at 1440x900. Also the drawing content is centred (~530px wide inside a 1408px box) while the cx-insp-states strip spans the full width, so each cell is horizontally far from the label that describes it - the one-to-one reading is not visually apparent.

The 9-discipline convergence diagram overlaps the closing copy on mobile: GROUND, STRUCTURE, MATERIALS, DETAILING, EXECUTION labels collide with the H2 'Calculated. Detailed...' block and ENVELOPE collides with the 'A completed building...' paragraph at every progress sample (0, .3, .6, .85, 1.0). Visually confirmed - diagram lines/labels run across the headline and first paragraph.

'CONCEPTUAL SYNTHESIS - NO PERFORMANCE VALUES IMPLIED' sits detached from the diagram and intersects the 12 / RESULT + H2 text block bounding box at 1600x1000, 1440x900 and 1366x768 (only whitespace saves it visually).

Label collisions: at 834x1112 'STRUCTURE' (rotated band label) overlaps '* MOISTURE / VAPOUR CONTROL AS APPLICABLE' and 'FOUNDATION / FACADE' overlaps 'CONCEPTUAL - NOT TO SCALE - PERFORMANCE VALUES...'; at 390x844 both 'WEATHER' and 'STRUCTURE' overlap the '* MOISTURE / VAPOUR CONTROL AS APPLICABLE' footnote. Desktop (1600x1000, 1440x900) is clean.

Label collisions on mobile: cx-plot-service 'SHAFT / RISER' overlaps 'OCCUPIED SPACE' by 2.6px and cx-plot-flanking 'SEPARATING ELEMENT' / 'RECEIVER' sit 1.8px apart so they read as one string ('SEPARATING ELEMENTRECEIVER').

Only the active mark + disclaimer are shown and there is no overflow (ox=0), but the translucent annotation band starts at the very bottom edge of the rendered model, so it clips/abuts the foundation block of the model at 390x844.

At exactly progress 0 no annotation is highlighted (marks list empty) before mark 1 turns on at ~0.02; and the longitudinal bars keep translating into place until p~0.19 while mark 2 (transverse hoops) is already active from p=0.14, so phase 1 visually bleeds into phase 2.

issues: Engineering-drawing accuracy: the structure layer draws the slab lines as unbroken paths (M110 156 H570 / 272 / 388) straight through the coordinated shaft zone, so even at the two ENGINEERED OPENING markers the risers appear to pierce a continuous slab - the openings should read as breaks/gaps in the slab line.

The mid slab at y=272 is crossed by every riser (HVAC x=324, electrical x=334, water x=344, drainage x=356) but carries no opening/penetration annotation unless the Fire tab is active (where it becomes the FIRESTOP / COMPARTMENTATION INTERFACE). On the HVAC, Electrical, Water and Drainage tabs three slab crossings are shown with only two marked openings.

TS EN 13670 (Execution of Concrete Structures) and TS 708 (reinforcing steel) are grouped under STRUCTURE while the CONCRETE group contains only TS EN 206+A2 / TS 13515 - discipline attribution is arguable for a technical register.

action_items: Fix section 06 desktop state skipping: give every column a distinct stop (e.g. compute stops before clamping, or extend the rail's trailing padding so item 6 offsetLeft-pad < scrollWidth-innerWidth) so C.06 / cx-elstate-6 / the COMPLETION cell become reachable at progress 1.

Increase the .cx-insp-elem svg height (or split its 1200x200 viewBox / raise the label font-size) so the six cell labels and the 'VERIFICATION BEFORE WORK IS CONCEALED' heading are legible; align the drawing width with the cx-insp-states strip so each cell sits above its own label.
Stop the section 12 convergence diagram from overlapping the closing copy at 390x844 (stack it above the copy or hide/scale it on mobile).
Resolve the section 08 label collisions at 834x1112 and 390x844 (footnote vs rotated band labels; FOUNDATION / FACADE vs the CONCEPTUAL note).
Space the section 09 mobile labels (cx-plot-service and cx-plot-flanking) so no two labels touch.

Section 10: draw the two engineered openings as actual gaps in the slab line and annotate the third (mid-slab) riser crossing on the non-fire tabs, otherwise the services read as crossing solid slabs.
Optional: keep mark 1 highlighted at progress 0 and finish the longitudinal-bar entry before the hoop phase starts (05); lift the mobile annotation band clear of the model bottom edge.
critical_code_review_comments: js/construction.js horizontalScrub(): stops = items.map(it => clamp(it.offsetLeft - pad, 0, max)) collapses the trailing columns onto the same value; because idx is derived from the nearest stop, the final state can never win the tie. Any stepped horizontal rail whose last items fit inside the final translation will silently skip its last state.

css/construction.css .cx-insp-elem svg { max-height: clamp(60px, 9.5vh, 150px) } combined with a 1200x200 viewBox makes the 9px SVG labels render at ~4-5px; SVG text does not have a minimum legible size, so the cap must be tied to the required label size rather than vh.
Section 12 .cx-final-dwg is absolutely stacked over .cx-final-copy without a mobile guard, which produces guaranteed text-on-text at narrow widths.

success_rate.frontend: Functional: 11/12 checks pass (section 06 desktop 6th state unreachable). Layout/legibility: 6 defects across 06, 08, 09, 12.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified passing this round and safe to spot-check only: global ox=0 and zero SVG <text> viewport overflow at all 7 required viewports, no page/console errors (only benign WebGL 'GPU stall due to ReadPixels' performance warnings); 05 cage renders (WebGL context OK, 802x844 canvas, confinement zones green top+bottom with grey mid, foundation and cover box appear) and marks 1..6 highlight exactly one at a time and match phase() forwards and in reverse on desktop and mobile with the disclaimer always visible; 06 label/cell/column identity is exact at 1600x1000, 1440x900, 1366x768, 390x844 apart from the unreachable 6th desktop state; 07 trace draws monotonically (dashoffset 1 -> 0) and the gap/flag appear only at p .25-.35 while node 02 is active, all 15 labels present, correct top-to-bottom order, zero overlaps; 08 all control-layer, junction and note labels present, desktop clean; 09 all five schematics render source/path/assembly/receiver with numbering 01..05 and there are no dB/Rw values anywhere in the page text; 10 all seven tabs switch exactly one layer and set a unique caption, fire layer shows FIRE COMPARTMENT BOUNDARY + FIRESTOP / COMPARTMENTATION INTERFACE, both ENGINEERED OPENING markers present, no MEP label overlaps; 11 seven discipline groups each once with the APPLICABLE CURRENT EDITION tag and all 11 rows present (DOM order 1-7, 9, 8, 10, 11 which matches the group order); 12 photo dissolve reaches opacity 1; 01-04 regression fine (hero readout MATERIAL/GEOMETRY/STRUCTURAL FUNCTION, 6 structural element states, 5 seismic states, 6 concrete phases all cycle). After the fixes, re-test the 06 horizontal rail specifically at 1600x1000 and 1440x900 (must reach C.06) and re-check 08/09/12 label geometry at 834x1112 and 390x844.
rca_of_the_issue: Section 06 desktop state skipping: horizontalScrub() builds the per-column stop list with clamp(offsetLeft - pad, 0, max) where max = rail.scrollWidth - innerWidth. Measured at 1600x1000: scrollWidth 3216, innerWidth 1600, max 1616, stops [0,528,1056,1584,1616,1616]. Columns 5 and 6 therefore share stop 1616, and since idx is chosen as the stop nearest to the current translation with a strict '<' comparison, the earlier index (4) always wins, so index 5 is never emitted; the cumulative cell fill (i <= k) stops at 5 of 6 cells and C.06 never gets .is-on. Reproduce: scroll .cx-insp to progress 1.0 at any viewport wider than 1200px and taller than 820px and read [...document.querySelectorAll('.cx-insp-col')].findIndex(c=>c.classList.contains('is-on')) -> 4. Mitigation: derive stops from the un-clamped offsets (or add trailing rail padding) so every column has a unique stop, and/or select idx from the scroll progress bucket rather than from a tie-prone nearest-distance search.
